# NYC Taxi — Hourly Zone Heatmap

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Trip density by hour and zone

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime) as hour,
    pickup_location_id,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
FROM trips
WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2019-05-08'
  AND pickup_datetime < '2019-05-15'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime), pickup_location_id
ORDER BY hour, trip_count DESC
```
